title: Echo and Static
author: J. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Juniper Kavanagh, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
